local_copy_enabled.name: Local Copy
local_copy_enabled.description: Sync local copy of files in the '/backup' directory to a '/share' subfolder accessible within HA Core for automations and scripts

local_copy_subdir.name: Local folder
local_copy_subdir.description: Local target folder underneath '/share', separate multiple layers by a '/' slash charater, eg 'backups/your-choice'

ftps_enabled.name: FTPs Upload
ftps_enabled.description: Enable sync of files in the '/backup' directory to a FTPs server

ftps_host.name: FTPs Host
ftps_host.description: IP address or domain hostname of FTPs server

ftps_user.name: FTPs Username
ftps_user.description: Username to authenticate at FTPs server

ftps_password.name: FTPs Password
ftps_password.description: Password to authenticate at FTPs server

ftps_implicit.name: FTPs Implicit
ftps_implicit.description: Force implicit FTPs, if required, default 'off' as most servers use explicit

ftps_verify_cert.name: FTPs Certificate
ftps_verify_cert.description: Verify FTPs server certificate, disable in case your server only has a self-signed certificate

ftps_remote_dir.name: FTPs Path
ftps_remote_dir.description: Target folder at FTPs server, ensure ending with '/' slash character, e.g. 'backups/'

ftps_sync_deletions.name: FTPs Deletions
ftps_sync_deletions.description: Delete backups from FTPs server once they are removed locally
